title: GenLogic Schema
description: GenLogic YAML schema for Augmented Normalization - Foreign keys are DATA PIPELINES that create columns AND automation pathways

columns.description: Reusable column definitions that can be inherited and overridden in table definitions. Reusable columns can also inherit from other reusable columns using $ref.

tables.description: Table definitions with foreign keys as named data pipelines

^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,62}$.title: Valid PostgreSQL table name
^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,62}$.description: Must start with letter or underscore, followed by letters, numbers, or underscores (max 63 chars)

matching_tables.description: Pattern matching tables with fixed structure (id, string_match, result, range_low_bound, range_high_bound)

^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,62}$.title: Valid PostgreSQL table name
^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,62}$.description: Matching table with automatic structure and stored procedures (max 63 chars)

reusableColumnDefinition.description: Reusable column definition - can be SQL type string, full definition, or inherit from another reusable column

oneOf.description: SQL type string (e.g., 'serial primary key', 'varchar(100) unique')
Inherit from another reusable column with optional overrides

$ref.description: Name of reusable column to inherit from

columnDefinition.description: Column definition with SQL definition string and optional GenLogic features (automation, formula, comment)

definition.description: SQL definition string (e.g., 'varchar(100)', 'serial primary key', 'numeric(10,2) not null default 0')

automation.description: GENLOGIC CORE: Automation that references FK names, not table names

formula.description: SQL expression for formula column (e.g., 'column1 + column2'). Mutually exclusive with automation.

comment.description: Human-readable description of this column's purpose and usage (emits SQL COMMENT ON)

label.description: Human-readable label for UI display - follows through foreign keys and SYNC/SNAPSHOT automations

format.description: Format hint for UI rendering (e.g., 'currency', 'date', 'email') - follows through foreign keys and SYNC/SNAPSHOT automations

tableColumnDefinition.description: Table column: SQL type string, inherit from reusable column, or full definition with GenLogic features

oneOf.description: Null/empty value - inherit from reusable column of same name
SQL type string (e.g. 'varchar(100) not null') OR reference to reusable column name
Object with $ref - inherit from reusable column and override properties

$ref.description: Name of reusable column to inherit from

tableDefinition.description: Table definition with foreign keys as named data pipelines

comment.description: Human-readable description of this table's purpose and usage (emits SQL COMMENT ON)

columns.description: Column definitions - can inherit from reusable columns or define inline

foreign_keys.description: GENLOGIC CORE: Named data pipelines that create columns AND automation pathways

oneOf.description: Simple string shorthand: FK name = table name (e.g., 'category_id: categories')
Object syntax for complex cases (composite keys, multiple FKs to same table, special behavior)

unique_constraints.description: Composite unique constraints - each item is an array of column names that must be unique in combination

items.description: Array of column names forming a unique constraint

indexes.description: Non-unique indexes - each item is an array of column names to index together

items.description: Array of column names forming an index

seed-rows.description: Seed data rows to insert if not already present (checked by primary key)

items.description: Row data as key-value pairs matching column names. Values can be literals or $lookup objects for foreign key resolution.

foreignKeyDefinition.description: GENLOGIC: Foreign key as named data pipeline - creates columns and defines automation paths

comment.description: Human-readable description of this foreign key relationship

table.description: Target table name - VALIDATION REQUIRED: Must exist in 'tables' section

not_null.description: Whether the generated FK column(s) should be NOT NULL (required relationship)

delete.description: ON DELETE behavior - restrict (default) or cascade

auto_create_parent.description: GENLOGIC: Auto-create parent row with only PK when child references non-existent parent (requires parent to have PK)

auto_create.description: GENLOGIC: Auto-creation behavior when parent is referenced

autoCreateDefinition.description: Auto-creation configuration for FK-following record creation

spread.description: Spread configuration for date range expansion

start.description: Column name in parent table for range start

end.description: Column name in parent table for range end

interval.description: Column name in parent table for interval

generated_column.description: Column name in this (child) table for generated dates

copy_columns.description: Map of parent column to child column for value copying

literals.description: Map of child column to literal value

filter.description: Optional SQL WHERE condition for filtering auto-creation

matchingTableDefinition.description: Pattern matching table definition with automatic structure

comment.description: Human-readable description of this matching table

result_column_name.description: Name of the result column in the matching table

ruleMatchAutomationDefinition.description: Rule matching automation using stored procedure

source_table.description: Source table with rules - VALIDATION REQUIRED: Must exist in 'tables' section

match_column.description: Column specifying which destination column to match

target_value.description: Column with value to set in destination

destination_columns.description: Columns in destination table - VALIDATION REQUIRED: Must exist

overwrite_policy.description: When to overwrite existing values (default: if_null)
